title: Everything Is Easy
description: Wanted armor better than netherite? Done. Wanted diamonds and emeralds and iron whenever you want? Done. Want a gun that exlplodes stuff? Done. Want a hammer that rocks entities to space? DONE!
body:
Ever felt like causing **mass destruction**, making the game have free easy loot to grab, and have the ability to knock mobs into oblivion? This is the mod "Everything Is Easy" where you can weild giant hammers that have 10 knockback, **shoot explosions** out of guns, find new small structures with goodies inside, and have **armor BETTER than netherite**!
This mod adds **hammers**, **tnt guns**, **treasure rooms**, **crying obsidian armor**, and **crying obsidian tools**.
You can craft Crying Obsidian Armor with crying obsidian, and same with the tools.
The hammer is crafted with iron blocks and sticks.
Explodes can be crafted from a singular gunpowder.
Finally, the explode gun is crafted from a explode and 3 iron.
